problem_statement: The VFS should provide a new function `bool vfs_iterate_mount_dirs(vfs_DIR *dir)` that enumerates mounted file systems by their root directories in a way that can be used while other mounts or unmounts occur. A caller zero-initializes `dir`, then repeatedly calls the function; each successful call must return true and leave `dir` pointing at the root directory of the next mounted file system, with `dir->mp->mount_point` giving the mount point. It must continue in mount order, skip a mount point that has been unmounted before it is reached, and still report a mount point that is mounted later in the list, including one that is remounted at the end after being unmounted. When no further mounted file system is available, it must return false so that a later call after zero-initializing `dir` starts a new enumeration from the first mounted file system, and it must not leave the enumeration holding the mount points such that they cannot be unmounted after enumeration ends.
